sourceAudit.conclusion: Current runtime does not implement a native REDUCED -> RE-ADD lifecycle.

researchRules: A REDUCE signal is not proof of a reduce fill.
A reduce fill is not proof that the system entered a REDUCED or RE-ADD-eligible Formal state.
Realized REDUCE->RE-ADD economics require positively linked actual reduce and re-add fills.
Simple pair identity requires same symbol and same re-added quantity; otherwise inventory accounting is required.
Actual fill prices already include realized execution price and generic slippage must not be subtracted again.
Signal/reference-price modeling may include explicit slippage but must remain MODELED, never ACTUAL.
